messages:
ashley: Quick micro-sprint  need a distinct copy pass for three pages (Hosted API / Dedicated / Private) tied to the webinar funnel. Deliverables: hero, 3 bullets, one micro-benchmark, primary CTA mapping. Mobile-first.
maria: Keep it ultra-scannable. Primary CTA = Register Webinar on all pages; secondaries vary (Start Trial for Hosted, Request Quote for Dedicated/Private).
jon: Micro-bench ideas (one-liners): Hosted -> ~50 ms median token latency; Dedicated -> reserved GPU pools, ~5k tokens/sec sustained; Private -> audit-ready: SOC 2, KMS, on-prem optional. Link to methodology PDFs.
kevin: For wording, short bullets under hero: 1) Unified REST & SDK API across deployments 2) Predictable unit economics & autoscaling controls 3) Enterprise-grade security & auditability. Use active voice.
nashley: Hero options (very short): A) "One API. Any deployment." B) "Ship LLM features with production SLAs." Which is punchier?
maria: Combine: "One API. Any deployment. Production SLAs." Done.
kevin: Inbound form routing (ops-friendly snippet):
```
on_submit(form):
  capture: email, company, company_size, primary_use_case, wants_private, wants_dedicated, utm_campaign
  if form.company_size == 'enterprise' or form.request_quote:
    route -> sdr-enterprise@redwood.ai; tag: enterprise
  elif form.wants_dedicated:
    route -> solutions@redwood.ai; tag: dedicated-interest
  elif form.action == 'register_webinar':
    route -> marketing-webinars@redwood.ai; tag: webinar
  else:
    route -> selfserve@redwood.ai; tag: trial
```
jon: Also add a small scoring heuristic so SDRs get priority leads: enterprise + wants_private -> bump score. Send score in payload.
ops-bot: NOTE: enable captcha, utm capture, webhook retries, and include creative_id in payload. Webinar landing must be live Tue 09:00 PT.
marketing-bot: Reminder: Ashley finalize CTAs by Mon 16:00 PT.
ashley: I'll drop A/B hero variants plus 3 CTA copy options into Website Copy doc and flag preference. Will add micro-benchmark lines linking to PDFs.
maria: Kevin prepare one-page benchmark PDFs (methodology + sample prompts) and post links here. We'll review Mon 10:30 PT. :rocket:
